page.overview:
Who is Barracuda Guardian?

Barracuda Guardians are minifigures from the Atlantis theme. They are creatures that lurk deep in the seas of Atlantis.

The Barracuda Guardian has a torso element with a mouth printed on it and an exclusive head mould, all in Sand Green The head has seaweed-like marks on it, and has holes to connect two tooth elements to. He has a hole for the body-printed mouth.
